item.title: Documents detail manhunt ending in Dublin man’s arrest
item.description: Around 5 p.m. on Dec 3 , residents in West Menlo Park had to shelter-in place briefly after a man with several felony warrants fled the Sunnyvale Department of Public Safety. Now, a week after the initial incidents, new documents detail the efforts to apprehend the individual and his crimes.
